Walmart’s Digital Sales Are Now Driving Its Growth, Not Stores

Store sales fell again in most recent quarter, while retailer’s revenue from e-commerce, advertising and other newer businesses is growing

By

Walmart WMT -1.04 % decrease; down pointing triangle is moving further away from relying on store sales.

On Thursday, Walmart said its sales and profits from e-commerce, advertising and other newer businesses were growing, while its store sales continued to slide.
